title: Add bee report outcomes: per-layer counts of how often each check changed a result
action: Add a read-only verb `bee report outcomes [--feature <slug>] [--json]` (D3, store e4711613). It reads every cell JSON under .bee/cells/*.json and .bee/cells/archive/<feature>/*.json of the store root (filtered by the cell's feature when --feature is given) and prints one row per layer: (1) worker reaction: counts of confirm, partial, challenge, blocked, null, and absent (trace.reaction key missing) kept apart; (2) dissent: number of trace.dissent entries and counts by verdict (accept, reject, escalate, unanswered); (3) semantic judge: trace.semantic_judge entries by verdict (PASS, NEEDS_REVISION, other); (4) leader check: trace.leader_check entries by verdict; (5) rework: cells with trace.reopened_for_rework truthy; (6) role reroute: cells with a non-empty top-level role_reroutes. For each layer print how many cells carry a record and how many records changed a result (dissent accepted or escalated, judge NEEDS_REVISION, leader check not ok, reopen, reroute, reaction partial/challenge/blocked). A layer with zero cells carrying the record prints `not recorded`, never 0. The output carries NO advice line: never suggest adding, removing, or tuning a layer. --json emits the same numbers. Unreadable cell files are counted and named, never a crash. Wire it like report usage (verbs/mod.rs try_native chain, router.rs list, the registry payload via the same regen path the report usage entry uses). Red first: write the tests over a temp store with fixture cells (one per layer state, one archived, one feature-filtered out) and watch them fail before the verb exists. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: sag-1`. ROUND 2 (goal-check miss on a7576e63b): run() resolves the store with resolve_store_root_any, so inside a linked feature worktree it counts the worktree tracked copy of .bee/cells instead of the control-plane store in the main checkout. Fix it the way verbs/report.rs does (resolve_store_root_worktree, read cells from roots.root) and add a test with a linked-worktree fixture (pattern: the verbs/report.rs test near line 1059) proving the main store is read. Keep the rest of a7576e63b; the COMMAND_SURFACE_BUDGET_CHARS bump in hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs is accepted. Commit the fix as a new commit with trailer cell: sag-1, then cap with bee cells finish.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- report_outcomes registry
